Exactly one coherent subject appears with the full hair mass, head, braid, both empty hands, layered apron, both trouser legs, and both shoes completely visible inside generous parchment margins.
The grounded three-quarter stance, leading shoulder, wide staggered feet, lowered empty hands, and clean silhouette read clearly as a weaponless combat ready-idle.

The heavily repaired workwear, practical shoes, and waist ties remain ordinary mortal goods; no weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
